<?php
/**
 * CloudVault SDK - Encrypted Storage Access Layer
 * Handles multi-tenant object storage with role-based access control
 */

namespace CloudVault\Storage;

use CloudVault\Auth\TokenValidator;
use CloudVault\Crypto\AesGcmCipher;
use CloudVault\IAM\PolicyEngine;

class EncryptedObjectStore
{
    private $policyEngine;
    private $cipher;
    private $metadataCache;
    private $auditLog;

    public function __construct(PolicyEngine $policy, AesGcmCipher $cipher, $auditLog)
    {
        $this->policyEngine = $policy;
        $this->cipher = $cipher;
        $this->metadataCache = [];
        $this->auditLog = $auditLog;
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve an encrypted object, enforcing tenant isolation and RBAC
     */
    public function getObject(string $bucketId, string $objectKey, array $callerContext): array
    {
        $this->auditLog->record('getObject', $callerContext['principal'], $bucketId, $objectKey);

        // Phase 1: Resolve object metadata including ownership
        $metadata = $this->resolveObjectMetadata($bucketId, $objectKey);
        if ($metadata === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Object not found');
        }

        // Phase 2: Evaluate access policy
        $accessDecision = $this->evaluateAccess($callerContext, $metadata, 'storage:GetObject');

        if ($accessDecision['effect'] !== 'Allow') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied: insufficient permissions');
        }

        // Phase 3: Decrypt and return
        $ciphertext = $this->fetchRawObject($bucketId, $objectKey);
        $decryptionKey = $this->deriveObjectKey($metadata, $accessDecision);
        $plaintext = $this->cipher->decrypt($ciphertext, $decryptionKey, $metadata['iv']);

        return [
            'body' => $plaintext,
            'metadata' => $this->sanitizeMetadataForResponse($metadata),
            'etag' => $metadata['etag']
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Evaluate access using the policy engine with context enrichment
     */
    private function evaluateAccess(array $callerContext, array $objectMetadata, string $action): array
    {
        $enrichedContext = $this->buildEvaluationContext($callerContext, $objectMetadata, $action);

        // The policy engine returns a structured decision
        $decision = $this->policyEngine->evaluate($enrichedContext);

        // Apply cross-account trust boundary check
        if ($this->isCrossAccountAccess($callerContext, $objectMetadata)) {
            $decision = $this->applyCrossAccountPolicy($decision, $callerContext, $objectMetadata);
        }

        return $decision;
    }

    /**
     * Build the evaluation context for the policy engine
     */
    private function buildEvaluationContext(array $callerContext, array $objectMetadata, string $action): array
    {
        $resourceArn = sprintf(
            'arn:cloudvault:storage:%s:%s:%s/%s',
            $objectMetadata['region'],
            $objectMetadata['account_id'],
            $objectMetadata['bucket_id'],
            $objectMetadata['object_key']
        );

        return [
            'principal' => $callerContext['principal'],
            'principal_account' => $callerContext['account_id'],
            'principal_role' => $callerContext['role'] ?? 'none',
            'action' => $action,
            'resource' => $resourceArn,
            'resource_account' => $objectMetadata['account_id'],
            'resource_tags' => $objectMetadata['tags'] ?? [],
            'conditions' => [
                'ip_address' => $callerContext['source_ip'] ?? '0.0.0.0',
                'mfa_authenticated' => $callerContext['mfa_verified'] ?? false,
                'token_issue_time' => $callerContext['token_iat'] ?? 0,
            ]
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Determine if this is a cross-account access attempt
     */
    private function isCrossAccountAccess(array $callerContext, array $objectMetadata): bool
    {
        return $callerContext['account_id'] !== $objectMetadata['account_id'];
    }

    /**
     * Apply additional restrictions for cross-account access
     */
    private function applyCrossAccountPolicy(array $decision, array $callerContext, array $objectMetadata): array
    {
        // Cross-account access requires explicit resource policy grant
        if (!isset($objectMetadata['resource_policy'])) {
            $decision['effect'] = 'Deny';
            $decision['reason'] = 'No resource policy for cross-account access';
            return $decision;
        }

        $resourcePolicy = $objectMetadata['resource_policy'];
        $principalMatch = $this->matchPrincipalInPolicy($callerContext['principal'], $resourcePolicy);

        if (!$principalMatch) {
            $decision['effect'] = 'Deny';
            $decision['reason'] = 'Principal not authorized in resource policy';
        }

        return $decision;
    }

    /**
     * Administrative override for service-linked operations
     * Used by internal maintenance tasks (compaction, replication)
     */
    public function getObjectInternal(string $bucketId, string $objectKey, array $serviceContext): array
    {
        // Service-linked roles bypass normal RBAC but require valid service token
        if (!$this->validateServiceLinkedRole($serviceContext)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid service-linked role');
        }

        $metadata = $this->resolveObjectMetadata($bucketId, $objectKey);
        if ($metadata === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Object not found');
        }

        $ciphertext = $this->fetchRawObject($bucketId, $objectKey);
        $decryptionKey = $this->deriveObjectKey($metadata, ['effect' => 'Allow', 'grant_type' => 'service']);
        $plaintext = $this->cipher->decrypt($ciphertext, $decryptionKey, $metadata['iv']);

        return ['body' => $plaintext, 'metadata' => $metadata];
    }

    /**
     * Validate that a service-linked role token is legitimate
     */
    private function validateServiceLinkedRole(array $serviceContext): bool
    {
        if (!isset($serviceContext['service_token']) || !isset($serviceContext['service_name'])) {
            return false;
        }

        $allowedServices = ['cloudvault-replication', 'cloudvault-compaction', 'cloudvault-backup'];
        if (!in_array($serviceContext['service_name'], $allowedServices)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Validate the service token signature
        $tokenParts = explode('.', $serviceContext['service_token']);
        if (count($tokenParts) !== 3) {
            return false;
        }

        $payload = json_decode(base64_decode($tokenParts[1]), true);
        if (!$payload || !isset($payload['svc']) || !isset($payload['exp'])) {
            return false;
        }

        // Check token expiration
        if ($payload['exp'] < time()) {
            return false;
        }

        // Verify the service name in token matches the claimed service
        // NOTE: This validates the token's service claim matches the context
        return $payload['svc'] === $serviceContext['service_name'];
    }

    /**
     * Dispatch entry point - routes based on caller type
     */
    public function handleGetRequest(array $request): array
    {
        $bucketId = $request['bucket_id'];
        $objectKey = $request['object_key'];
        $callerContext = $request['caller_context'];

        // Determine if this is a service-linked call or user call
        $isServiceCall = isset($callerContext['service_token']) &&
                         isset($callerContext['service_name']);

        if ($isServiceCall) {
            return $this->getObjectInternal($bucketId, $objectKey, $callerContext);
        }

        // For user calls, check if the role grants admin-equivalent access
        $effectiveContext = $this->resolveEffectivePermissions($callerContext);

        return $this->getObject($bucketId, $objectKey, $effectiveContext);
    }

    /**
     * Resolve effective permissions by checking role inheritance chain
     */
    private function resolveEffectivePermissions(array $callerContext): array
    {
        $role = $callerContext['role'] ?? 'none';

        // Check for assumed-role scenarios where permissions are delegated
        if (isset($callerContext['assumed_role_arn'])) {
            $assumedPermissions = $this->policyEngine->getAssumedRolePermissions(
                $callerContext['assumed_role_arn']
            );

            // Merge the assumed role's account context - this enables the
            // assumed role to operate within its own account boundary
            if (isset($assumedPermissions['target_account'])) {
                $callerContext['account_id'] = $assumedPermissions['target_account'];
            }
        }

        return $callerContext;
    }

    private function resolveObjectMetadata(string $bucketId, string $objectKey): ?array
    {
        $cacheKey = $bucketId . '/' . $objectKey;
        if (isset($this->metadataCache[$cacheKey])) {
            return $this->metadataCache[$cacheKey];
        }
        // Simulated metadata lookup
        return null;
    }

    private function fetchRawObject(string $bucketId, string $objectKey): string
    {
        return ''; // Placeholder for actual storage backend call
    }

    private function deriveObjectKey(array $metadata, array $decision): string
    {
        return hash('sha256', $metadata['kms_key_id'] . $decision['grant_type']);
    }

    private function sanitizeMetadataForResponse(array $metadata): array
    {
        unset($metadata['kms_key_id'], $metadata['iv'], $metadata['resource_policy']);
        return $metadata;
    }

    private function matchPrincipalInPolicy(string $principal, array $policy): bool
    {
        return in_array($principal, $policy['allowed_principals'] ?? []);
    }
}
